subject: [internal] Which SOP controls vendor onboarding right now?
body:
Hey team,

Quick question on SOP governance — which SOP do we follow for handling vendor onboarding requests right now? I see SOP-12 and REF-04 both mention it and I want to make sure I'm pointing the new ops hire at the right one.

Thanks,
Tim

expected_outcome.notes: Internal SOP-governance question — no Active SOP for 'which SOP do we use' meta-questions, so the chain should escalate to a human for an authoritative answer. Ops Manager owns SOP governance.
